author: Cubbe
body:
-Age: 16, turning 17 in 
-Timezone: UTC/GMT -5 hours
-Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes
-Do you have access to Skype? Yes
-Do you have access to a recording software? Yes (Bought Action)

Criteria 1

-Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?

Not really, I used to be a moderator on a scrimmage network server, did some screenshares and such but nothing on a big server.

-What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating?

I get angry easily when I see people harassing, probably I can make mistakes on punishments like Banning instead of Kicking or Making a Ban longer than it should be

- What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

I am a really active player that has been on the pvp community for 3 years  now and on that time I learned about hacked clients / ghost clients and how to know if someone is using an ilegal client on the server

-How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

I can speak Spanish and English fluently, maybe I can help not only as a mod but as a translator as well. Also I'm active so I can help in any way you want, checking the forums, the server chat, etc.

-What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

I think a leader needs to be perseverant on what he does, leading a team is hard and you can think many times on quitting, but you have to be perseverant and keep going, also a leader needs to be friendly so the team feels comfortable with him. I wouldn't consider myself to be a leader since I'm not really patient with people

-What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

As I said before, I have a lot of experience on the PvP Community and I know how to detect ilegal clients via ScreenShare, via 1st person or via 3rd person, that might not be that easy to find out and I think I may know more than other players about ilegal client modifications

-What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

Being friendly, talkative and active. If you are friendly, the community will like you, if you are talkative the community will think you care of them, and if you are active the community will know that you will always be there for them. Yes I have those skills, apart from a staff member I want to be a known user in the community by being their friend

-How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 

I can join whenver I want until april, so I would be 100% active, but when I start college I would be active from afternoon to late night and I think I can do it for a year or more

Criteria 2

-You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

I would tell him to stop, trying to convince him that he should not do it via PM, the console makes Auto Bans with ban evaders but in case that the console does not ban him I would do it by myself.

-Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

I would contact a Higher Staff member like a Senior Mod or and Administrator and let them know about the bad behaviour of the staff member that was bothering the team's channel so they take the right decision and decide what to do with that staff member

-A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?


I always have action opened and record almost everything. I always try to have a back up on my computer of my recordings. In case that the evidence file gets corrupted I would not appeal it, me and he know that he broke the rules, there is no need to lie.

-You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

I would take a screenshot to use it as evidence of what he made. and give it to higher staff. He might be on the same team as me but if he breaks the rules he has to be responsible of what he made

-One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

I would join discord or teamspeak to talk with the senior staff and try to explain him why I do not like the decision he took, and tell him to explain me why he made it, after that I would think if that decision is the best for the server and the community, if it is like that  I would stop complaining and just keep doing my job as a staff member but if it isn't I would try to convince him to change his decision and look for one everyone likes.

Criteria 3

-What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

A chance to make something I always wanted to do, moderate a server with the gamemodes I like, and keeping the server clean from cheaters / people that harass

-How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

 I find this server interesting, I stopped playing it but now that I came back I realised that the changes you made were the best. I can say I like this server and I plan to play a lot on here. For me, Avicus is a server where I found my friends and where we shared good experiences, also a server with a huge potential with its gamemodes and surely we can make it grow!

-Do you speak any other languages than English?

Spanish

-Do you have anything else to add to your application?

You won't regret of having me as a moderator ;)
